summary: Modern freestanding fire tower that OpenStreetMap says is not accessible to the public. No build date or history found.

access.note: OpenStreetMap says the tower is not accessible to the public.

evidence.quote: Modern fire tower, not accessible by public.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the OSM node tags and description. Two web searches found no page naming a Curry Run lookout. Grep of the cached PA storymap, Wikipedia lookout list, FFLA, FFLOS, GNIS and NHLR pages found no mention. Check the DCNR tower map and the local forest office for ownership, build date and status. Access is recorded as restricted (OSM: 'not accessible by public'); the story tells visitors not to climb it. Coordinates are 40.9509, -78.7490.
